title: Cinnamon in Mauritius
content:
## Varieties of cinnamon
They are distinguished by the pungency of bark and structure of leaves. 

## Propagation
They are propagated by seeds. Only non fermented and heavy seeds are taken after 2 - 4 days. 

Cuttings from three leaved shoots. COver in shade for 3 to 4 months to prevent water loss from evo-evaporation. The rooted plants are available in 10-12 months. 

Air layering propagation: 50 - 87% success

## Field planting
Should be planted at spacing of 1.2m x 0.6m with 3 plants in one hole. 

## Maintenance:
Sloppy land: COntour drains, Add mulch with branch and weeds
Fertilizer: 2N x 1 P x  at 6 month interval 50cm around plant root

## Harvesting
Ready for harvest in 2 to 3 years when around 1.5 m and bark turns brown color. 

## Business cases
Commercial products: Cinnamon bark oil, cimnnamon leaf oil, quills, quillings, featherings, chips

## Tools: 
Curved knife for scrapping outer dead bark surface
knife pointed on one side for ripping side branches
brass or wooden rod to loosen sbark
specifically pointed knife to remove loosened bark


Preparation of shoots for peeling
Mature shoots arecut down three months before peeling. 

1. Scrape brak with steel scrapper
2. Bark is thoroughly rubbed with wooden or brass rod to loosen it from woody stem
3. Longitudinal line dran from end to end of bark and on opposide side of the bark
4. Two equal halves of long barks peeled from either side of stick
5. The trimmed with scissors
6. Leave for drying on a mat on shaded region not in sunlight

## Grading
Quills are graded according to foxing ( amount of dark brown on surface). Depending on foxing, sie, color they are graded. Finest are graded 00000 and coarses are 0.
